name: Qiu Lin
source:
Qiu has a few quirks that everyone familiar with him knows, and one is the notebook he's always got hand. Autumn is scatterbrained, needing to sort his thoughts by actually writing them down. He also commonly uses it to leave little notes for people when he's got something to say.

With easy charm and confidence, Qiu sets the pace on the cozy street where he was born. He'll welcome you to his world with open arms' happy to take you under his wing if you're in need of a friend.
